title: PNC XMas Price Index
text: I developed JavaScript for the data display in PNC’s 2012 Christmas Price Index experience. The site paired the annual pricing of gifts from “The Twelve Days of Christmas” with a worldwide gift hunt built around Google Street View. Visitors could examine the total index and the price history of individual gifts in dedicated data screens. My work focused on that presentation of the numbers within the larger campaign. The project received FWA Site of the Day and the Cutting Edge Award.
summary: I developed JavaScript for the data display in PNC’s Christmas Price Index experience, presenting historical gift prices alongside an award-winning global gift hunt.
